one_line: Legendary early Guhila leader of Mewar, later remembered as a founder-hero of Chittor in Rajput tradition.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean but strong warrior build, about 5'9" in proportionally athletic shonen style
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, warm wheat-brown complexion typical of Rajputana, sharp dark-brown eyes with thick brows, a neatly kept black moustache and short boxed beard, default expression calm and resolute with a hint of youthful intensity.
appearance.hair: Thick, wavy black hair to just above the shoulders, parted slightly off-center and tucked behind the ears; he wears a simple early Rajput-style cloth turban (pag) in deep saffron with a narrow dark-green band wrapped around the base and a small, plain metal dome cap hidden under the cloth for light protection.
appearance.costume: Early-medieval Rajput warrior attire: a long, knee-length quilted cotton coat (padded tunic) in muted indigo blue with vertical stitch lines and a subtle diamond quilting pattern, fastened with cloth ties over a light off-white cotton angarkha-style inner garment whose folded neckline peeks at the chest; a narrow, dark-red cotton sash (patka) wraps twice around his waist, knotted at the left hip with the loose ends hanging to mid-thigh; on his lower body he wears slightly tapered, sand-colored cotton churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles, and soft brown leather ankle boots with simple stitching; over his shoulders he carries a light, undyed beige cotton shawl/cloak (like an early rajput chadar) draped from the left shoulder across his back and pinned at the right, practical for desert nights; armour is modest—a riveted iron-and-leather lamellar panel strapped over his chest under the shawl, visible as overlapping dark metal plates laced with leather thongs, plus simple round iron bracers on his forearms; minimal jewellery: a single small copper hoop earring in each ear and a plain, slightly worn copper armlet on his right upper arm; a small tilak of red ochre is occasionally visible on his forehead under the turban band.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved early Indian iron sword with a broad single-edged blade (proto-tulwar), plain crossguard and a dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt ending in a simple disk pommel, carried in a brown leather scabbard edged with brass fittings and suspended from his red waist sash on his left side.

ref_desc: Bappa Rawal is a mid-20s wheat-brown Rajput warrior with shoulder-length wavy black hair under a deep saffron turban, indigo quilted coat over off-white garments, sand-colored trousers, brown boots, red waist sash, beige shoulder-cloak, and a plain curved iron sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Bappa Rawal as a historically grounded early-medieval Rajput warrior: a mid-20s, lean but strong man with an oval wheat-brown face, straight nose, sharp dark-brown eyes, thick brows, and a neat black moustache with a short boxed beard, expression calm and resolute with youthful intensity. His thick wavy black hair falls to just above his shoulders and is mostly covered by a simple early Rajput cloth turban in deep saffron, wrapped around a small hidden metal dome cap, with a narrow dark-green band at the base. He wears a knee-length quilted cotton coat in muted indigo blue, with vertical stitch lines and a subtle diamond pattern, tied at the front so that the folded neckline of an off-white cotton angarkha-style inner garment shows at the chest. A narrow dark-red cotton sash wraps twice around his waist, knotted at his left hip with ends hanging to mid-thigh, also supporting a brown leather scabbard with brass fittings. His trousers are sand-colored, slightly tapered churidar-style cotton, gathered neatly at the ankles, and he wears soft brown leather ankle boots with simple stitching. Over his shoulders is a light beige cotton shawl or cloak, draped from the left shoulder across his back and pinned at the right, partially covering a modest lamellar chest defence made of overlapping dark metal plates laced with leather straps, plus plain round iron bracers on his forearms; no fantasy armor. Add minimal jewellery: a small copper hoop earring in each ear and a plain copper armlet on his right upper arm, and suggest a faint red tilak under the turban band. His signature weapon is a slightly curved early Indian iron sword with a broad single-edged blade, a plain crossguard, dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt, and simple disk pommel, worn at his left hip in the brown leather scabbard. Use an earthy palette of indigo blue, deep saffron, dark red, sand beige, and brown leather, and present him front, side, and back to clearly show face, hair, clothing, and sword design.
